rust_summary: a player opening and closing a menu (`native_player_container_open`, `native_player_container_close`).
doc_summary: a player opening and closing any menu on a server, on the single player server thread and on a dedicated server: `native_player_container_open(player, name, dimension, menu, pos)` and `native_player_container_close(...)` (NeoForge's `PlayerContainerEvent.Open` and `.Close`), with the menu type's name and, for a block's menu, its position. They run with the player's state swapped in. Unlike the viewer count of a mod container (`native_mod_container_viewers`) they name the player and cover every menu: chests, furnaces, crafting tables, trades, a mod's own. A menu is heard once a tick, so one opened and closed inside a tick is not; each open has one close, also when the player leaves. Bundles that use them need "hooks": @API:player_container_events@.
